A second Lys266 contact stabilizes the fused imidazole face of the purine ring.
Asp264 accepts a hydrogen bond from the NH adjacent to the purine scaffold.

The linker NH donates a hydrogen bond to Glu151.
Glu152 forms a hydrogen bond with the cyclohexanol hydroxyl group.
